title: AI Daily 2026-11-13 · Handoffs
description: NVIDIA changes leadership, Google hands tasks between models, chatbots surface risky shopping sites, and Nebius finances construction with customer prepayments.

nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns-kress-interi.topic: Jensen Huang resigns as NVIDIA CEO and director, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns-kress-interi.verification_scope: Full NVIDIA announcement, opening of WIRED through company background, both internal emails published by The Verge, and full TechCrunch brief reviewed. The New York Times, Financial Times, Bloomberg and NBC originals were not opened. The assessment of the subordinate relationship and Megaspeed dealings rests on one anonymous WIRED source.

google-gemini-4-hydrogen-orchestrator.topic: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, replacing 3.8 Flash and becoming Search AI Mode's default
google-gemini-4-hydrogen-orchestrator.verification_scope: Google model post through safety, Search and Antigravity posts, and full Verge article reviewed. Ars Technica returned HTTP 403. Benchmarks, speed and safety are Google's reports. Official posts disagree on the Orchestrator benchmark version, 4.0 versus 4.1. No hands-on test.

podqi-study-chatbots-risky-shopping-site.topic: Study finds fake or defunct shopping websites in up to 15% of chatbot responses
podqi-study-chatbots-risky-shopping-site.verification_scope: Full Verge article reviewed. Podqi's report was not opened, and figures follow The Verge. Podqi sells brand protection and tested a client.

nebius-2027-capex-prepayments-delays.topic: Nebius plans $40–45 billion of 2027 spending, largely financed through customer prepayments and contracts
nebius-2027-capex-prepayments-delays.verification_scope: Full TechCrunch article reviewed. Nebius earnings documents, call transcript and contract summary, Bloomberg and Floodlight originals were not opened. Relevant material follows TechCrunch.

fireworks-ai-breach-notion-ai-transcript.topic: Fireworks AI confirms theft of customer billing information and some datasets, affecting about 1% of Notion customers
fireworks-ai-breach-notion-ai-transcript.verification_scope: Full TechCrunch article reviewed. Fireworks' notice and Notion's disclosure were not opened. Reporting follows TechCrunch.

nvidia-privately-confirmed-chip-tracking.topic: US lawmaker says NVIDIA privately acknowledged chip-location tracking was feasible
nvidia-privately-confirmed-chip-tracking.verification_scope: Full MIT Technology Review article reviewed. NVIDIA has not confirmed Foster's account. Bill text and industry-association letter were not opened.

deepmind-uk-staff-union-cac-application.topic: Google DeepMind staff in Britain apply to a government arbitration body for a union vote
deepmind-uk-staff-union-cac-application.verification_scope: Most of WIRED through employee quotations reviewed. The Central Arbitration Committee application was not opened.

softbank-turbine-deposit-writeoff.topic: More than half of SoftBank's $7.1 billion quarterly loss comes from power-equipment deposit impairments
softbank-turbine-deposit-writeoff.verification_scope: Full TechCrunch analysis reviewed. SoftBank earnings documents and Financial Times reporting were not opened.

maya-site-ai-agents-already-documented.topic: A Maya site found using 48 AI agents had appeared in an academic journal more than a year earlier
maya-site-ai-agents-already-documented.verification_scope: Most of The Verge through Graham's comments reviewed. Miotti's blog and prior journal paper were not opened.

minimax-h3-image-open-weights-report.topic: Qbitai reports that MiniMax has open-sourced H3-Image
minimax-h3-image-open-weights-report.verification_scope: Most of Qbitai's hands-on article reviewed. Official MiniMax release and license were not checked. Hugging Face API confirmed repository creation on November 3 at 06:34:36 UTC. No hands-on testing.

ibm-granite-llmon-preview.topic: IBM Granite's LLMON separates instructions from data in a markup language for language models
ibm-granite-llmon-preview.verification_scope: Opening of Hugging Face post, release and capability descriptions, relationship to JSON and chat templates, and examples reviewed. GitHub and model cards were not opened. License unverified. Attack-success claims are authors' reports without specific figures. Not run.

paper-ai-overviews-health-citations.topic: Related-paper retrospective estimates that only about 57% of cited health claims in Google AI Overviews are supported by their sources
paper-ai-overviews-health-citations.verification_scope: arXiv 2610.39339 v1 HTML, abstract, introduction, sections 2.1–2.3, 3.1 and table A5, 3.2–3.4 and table 3, discussion limitations and appendix on automated coding reviewed. Sections 2.4–2.7 and robustness section 3.5 were not reviewed paragraph by paragraph. Only v1 exists.

discourse-dylan-patel-compute-concentrat.topic: Dylan Patel argues that compute will concentrate if labs are its most effective users
discourse-dylan-patel-compute-concentrat.verification_scope: Published Concourse guide, speaker information, two automatically extracted caption-based excerpts from chapter 01:07:52, and context reviewed. Full program not reviewed. Paraphrase only.

discourse-matt-garman-agent-first-cloud.topic: Matt Garman describes agent-first engineering, with engineers managing teams of agents
discourse-matt-garman-agent-first-cloud.verification_scope: Published Concourse guide based on publisher description, marked full program pending review, and two caption-based excerpts at 00:08:46 and 00:54:02 reviewed. Full program not reviewed. Paraphrase only.
